Container.Name: stats-for-picnic
Container.Overview: Calm, self-hosted grocery & recipe nutrition companion for Picnic (with optional read-only Mealie integration), 1-click re-add from past orders, OpenFoodFacts + DeepSeek Flash enrichment cache, and Tesserae E-Ink / Home Assistant endpoints. Single container, single SQLite file. All settings (Picnic 2FA, Demo Mode, Mealie, LLM, API Key, Sync Interval) are configured directly in the Web-UI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Web-UI, JSON API (/api/v1/summary) and E-Ink widget (/widget/eink).

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database (app.db), encryption key, and cached Mealie recipe images.
